about: The city's airport stands where it really is (city/airfield.js): its runways, terminal and parked planes, traffic in the air, and its place on the city map. Run in any open city (--city Lagos --area Yaba; Accra Osu; Nairobi "City Centre"). The free camera holds the game's own still for a look from the air.

steps.log: (() => { const a = window.__bw.look.openWorld.airport; return { name: a.name, runways: a.runways.map((r) => r.ref.join('/')), km: Math.round(Math.hypot(...a.center) / 100) / 10 }; })()

steps.name: a plane is in the air (landing or taking off)

steps.eval: () => { const B = window.__bw, A = B.look.openWorld.airport, o = B.look.openWorld.offset, C = B.camera, P = C.position, set = P.set.bind(P), look = C.lookAt.bind(C); P.copy = () => P; C.lookAt = () => {}; const cx = A.center[0] - o.x, cz = A.center[1] - o.z, d = Math.hypot(cx, cz) || 1; set(cx - (cx / d) * 2600, 1300, cz - (cz / d) * 2600); look(cx, 0, cz); }

() => { const B = window.__bw, a = B.look.openWorld.airfield, p = a.planes().filter((v) => v.y > 30).sort((x, y) => x.y - y.y)[0]; a.frozen = true; const C = B.camera, P = C.position; P.set.call(P, p.x + 60, p.y + 15, p.z - 70); Object.getPrototypeOf(C).lookAt.call(C, p.x, p.y, p.z); }
